meta.notes: Federal vehicle-related limits for Section 179 validation. Update annually from IRS official publications. These are the IRC Section 179 deduction limits specific to certain vehicles, NOT general depreciation limits.
meta.disclaimer: These limits apply to SUVs and certain trucks/vans with GVWR between 6,000-14,000 lbs. Passenger automobiles have different depreciation limits (not Section 179). Heavy vehicles over 14,000 lbs GVWR are not subject to Section 179 caps.

2018.notes: IRC Section 179 limit for SUVs placed in service in 2018
